subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

She had an ability to __persuade__ others.
solution:
The correct answer is "**impress**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Persuade" means to convince someone to do or believe something**.

 
 
• Example: It was difficult to persuade her.
 
 
 
• **"Impress" means to make someone feel admiration or respect**.
 
 
• Example: She is always trying to impress people.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is correct that the word "impress" can substitute the word "persuade."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "**halt**", means to stop or pause something.
 
• Option 2, "**suppress**", means to prevent something from being expressed or revealed.
 
• Option 3, "**outrage**", means to provoke anger or shock in someone.
